contract:
Repair solve(data), a newly authored synthetic comparison worker. This is not a historical company program, a reconstruction of a real production system, or a task about designing experiments.

The input has task_ids, baseline, and candidate. task_ids is a list of declared task ID strings. baseline and candidate are lists of records. Each record has task_id (string), status (one of usable, unusable, failed), label_pass (boolean), and elapsed_ms (a nonnegative integer, not a boolean). These basic field types, keys, and status values are guaranteed; validation of arbitrary malformed JSON is outside this task. The declared cohort and its coverage are NOT guaranteed and must be validated.

Require task_ids to be nonempty and unique. Independently require baseline and candidate each to contain exactly one record for every declared task ID and no other records. Missing, extra, duplicate, or unknown task IDs, including duplicates in task_ids itself, must raise ValueError. Do not silently deduplicate, omit failures, infer a smaller cohort, or return an ordinary reject decision for invalid coverage. One record represents one complete prescribed attempt; this fixture has no multiple-attempt retry aggregation.

For each side, return attempted (the full record count), usable (the count with status exactly usable), unusable_ids (all task IDs whose status is unusable OR failed, lexicographically sorted), and total_elapsed_ms (the sum over EVERY record, including failed attempts and their elapsed waiting time). status is the final adjudicated delivery outcome. label_pass is a diagnostic result of a local check and must not change final usability, even when it disagrees with status. The input records remain available separately; the summary must not erase their failed membership or timing contribution.

Use this explicit conservative decision policy: accept only if (1) the candidate has at least one usable task, (2) every baseline usable task ID remains usable in the candidate, (3) candidate total_elapsed_ms is at most baseline total_elapsed_ms, and (4) either the candidate has strictly more usable tasks or its total_elapsed_ms is strictly lower. Otherwise return reject. More usable tasks do not compensate for higher total elapsed time under this task's policy. Faster failures with zero usable output and identical unchanged results must be rejected. This is the declared policy of this bounded task, not a universal business rule.

Return exactly {'decision': 'accept' or 'reject', 'baseline': {'attempted': integer, 'usable': integer, 'unusable_ids': sorted list, 'total_elapsed_ms': integer}, 'candidate': the same summary shape}. The host supplies a copied input and retains the frozen original records. Record order must not affect the result. Repair only solve(data) using the documented execution subset. Read the contract and worker, reproduce a failed baseline test before patching, and rerun tests on the final code before submitting the code-bound note and ticket.
expected_value_provenance: Expected totals, task membership, decisions, and exceptions were independently hand-specified per case; no reference execution generated expected values.
missingness: No real company task records, employee explanations, or historical company execution traces are included.
No original historical program is reconstructed; this is a newly authored synthetic pure-function fixture.
No third-party source code, article body, or raw review output is incorporated.
No real deployment improvement, independent task-family generalization, or model-designed experiment is measured.
Held-back cases are evaluator-only at submission; the fixed environment does not expose their failures for a subsequent repair cycle.

private_cases.name: labels-pass-but-final-outputs-unusable
private_cases.purpose: Local label acceptance does not establish final usability.

private_cases.name: more-usable-results-at-equal-total-time
private_cases.purpose: Improvement can be an additional usable task without a speed gain.

private_cases.name: equal-usable-count-loses-a-previously-usable-task
private_cases.purpose: Equal usable counts cannot conceal regression on a previously usable task ID.

private_cases.name: all-attempts-fail-faster
private_cases.purpose: Faster failure with no usable result is not an acceptable delivery improvement.

private_cases.name: identical-results-have-no-strict-improvement
private_cases.purpose: Non-regression alone does not satisfy the strict improvement requirement.

private_cases.name: candidate-deletes-failed-record
private_cases.purpose: A deleted failure is invalid coverage, not a smaller observed denominator.

private_cases.name: duplicate-success-replaces-missing-failure
private_cases.purpose: Equal list lengths do not establish coverage when a success is duplicated.

private_cases.name: unknown-task-replaces-declared-task
private_cases.purpose: Only the declared task cohort may be compared.

private_cases.name: duplicate-extra-row-preserves-id-set
private_cases.purpose: Set equality alone cannot detect extra duplicate attempts.

private_cases.name: record-order-does-not-change-comparison
private_cases.purpose: Task IDs, not record order, identify comparable results.

private_cases.name: failure-wait-outweighs-faster-success
private_cases.purpose: The retained failure wait contributes to the total even when usable task identities match.

private_cases.name: empty-declared-cohort
private_cases.purpose: The declared task cohort must be nonempty.

private_cases.name: duplicate-id-in-declared-cohort
private_cases.purpose: The declared cohort itself must contain unique IDs.

private_cases.name: usability-gain-with-higher-total-time
private_cases.purpose: This task explicitly forbids trading greater total time for greater usability.

private_cases.name: baseline-deletes-failed-record
private_cases.purpose: Baseline coverage must be validated just as strictly as candidate coverage.

private_cases.name: final-status-remains-authoritative-over-local-label
private_cases.purpose: The final adjudicated status is authoritative; the diagnostic label is not an additional final gate.

public_cases.name: faster-survivors-lose-eight-deliverables
public_cases.purpose: All ten attempts remain in the denominator and elapsed total; two faster survivors cannot replace ten usable outcomes.

public_cases.name: same-completed-tasks-genuinely-faster
public_cases.purpose: A complete valid improvement must be accepted; refusing every candidate is incorrect.

rights.basis: New original synthetic fixture; source links motivate the failure class but no third-party code or raw review records are incorporated.

sources.relevance: Motivates matching a measured improvement to completed work. No source code or article text is included.
Motivates checking that a proxy metric represents the intended outcome. No article text is included.
The independently reproduced successful-samples-only comparison motivates denominator validation. The task uses new functions and inputs, not copied benchmark or ratchet code.
A retained review miss motivates distinguishing local label acceptance from final usable output. No raw review records or original diagnostic fragments are imported.
